name: NetXMS
description: Enterprise network and infrastructure monitoring platform covering SNMP, agents, NetFlow, and business services.

envVars.description: Password for the NetXMS PostgreSQL database user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DB_DRIVER: pgsql
      DB_SERVER: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      DB_NAME: netxms
      DB_LOGIN: netxms
      DB_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/var:/var/lib/netxms
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: netxms
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.DB_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: netxms
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
